name: N Candles v2
summary: This EA identifies and trades based on N consecutive candlestick patterns, entering positions when a specified number of consecutive bullish or bearish candles are detected. It uses a simple count-based reversal or continuation logic depending on configuration, with basic stop loss and take profit management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于N根连续K线形态进行交易，当检测到指定数量的连续阳线或阴线时开仓。根据配置可采用反转或延续逻辑，并配合基本的止损止盈管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是检测连续N根同方向K线（阳线或阴线），当达到设定数量时触发交易信号。入场条件为连续出现N根阳线后做空（反转逻辑）或做多（延续逻辑），连续N根阴线则相反。出场条件依赖固定止损止盈，没有移动止损或动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数，没有根据账户余额或波动率动态调整仓位的功能。资金管理方面缺乏风险控制，没有最大回撤限制或账户权益保护机制。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合特定市场环境但缺乏适应性。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy detects N consecutive directional candles (bullish or bearish) and triggers a trade signal when the configured count is reached. Entry conditions are based on counting consecutive bullish candles to sell (reversal logic) or buy (continuation logic), and vice versa for bearish candles. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing uses fixed lots without any dynamic adjustment based on account balance, equity, or market volatility. Money management lacks risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or account equity protection. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward, suitable for specific market conditions but lacks adaptability and robustness.

parameters.name: Stop_Loss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: Take_Profit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: Magic_Number
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

parameters.name: Reversal_Mode
parameters.description: 是否使用反转模式，true为反转，false为延续

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试
参数少，用户易于配置和优化
N根连续K线形态在特定市场状态下具有统计学意义的反转概率
反转和延续模式可切换，适应不同市场环境
代码结构简洁，执行效率高
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and debug
Few parameters make it easy for users to configure and optimize
N consecutive candle patterns have statistically meaningful reversal probability in certain market conditions
Reversal and continuation modes can be switched to adapt to different market environments
Clean code structure with high execution efficiency
cons: 固定手数没有动态仓位管理，风险控制不足
缺乏移动止损和动态出场机制，盈利可能回吐
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线重复开仓
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能不利
缺乏账户级别的风险保护，如最大回撤限制
连续K线策略在趋势行情中反转模式可能连续亏损
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing without dynamic position management provides insufficient risk control
Lack of trailing stop and dynamic exit mechanism may lead to profit giveback
No new bar check mechanism may cause repeated entries on the same candle
No spread filter may be disadvantageous in high-spread environments
Lack of account-level risk protection such as maximum drawdown limits
Reversal mode of consecutive candle strategy may suffer consecutive losses in trending markets
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额或ATR调整手数
添加新K线检查机制，避免同一根K线重复交易
增加移动止损和盈亏平衡点功能，保护已有利润
添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，减少不利条件下的交易
增加最大回撤限制和最大连续亏损次数限制
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account balance or ATR
Add new bar check mechanism to prevent repeated entries on the same candle
Add trailing stop and breakeven functionality to protect existing profits
Add spread filter and trading session filter to reduce trades under unfavorable conditions
Add maximum drawdown limit and maximum consecutive loss count limit

risk_points: 没有新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度持仓
固定手数无动态调整，大仓位可能造成较大亏损
止损止盈默认为0，不设止损风险极高
缺乏账户级别风险保护机制
反转模式在强趋势行情中可能连续逆势建仓
risk_points_en: No new bar check may cause repeated entries on the same candle leading to overexposure
Fixed lot sizing without dynamic adjustment may cause significant losses with large positions
Default stop loss and take profit of 0 creates extremely high risk without protective levels
Lack of account-level risk protection mechanisms
Reversal mode may continuously build positions against strong trends

summary_en: This EA identifies and trades based on N consecutive candlestick patterns, entering positions when a specified number of consecutive bullish or bearish candles are detected. It uses a simple count-based reversal or continuation logic depending on configuration, with basic stop loss and take profit management.
